results.note: Not met on attempt 3 either. The only tests that hit the real vendor (lines 258 and 301) are marked @pytest.mark.integration, and the gate run deselected them (396 passed, 76 deselected). The committed probe note, sosovalue-live-probe-local-attempt.md, admits the live call failed with WinError 10013 before any HTTP response came back. So the real response shape, date range and rate limit were never observed. BACKFILL_LIMIT was changed to 300 (ingest/fetchers/sosovalue.py:25) because a documentation page said so. That is the same kind of unconfirmed documentation-based assumption the 30-spec.md:6 tripwire says to replace with a live probe, so the tripwire is still open.
The backfill reuses _parse_money, which does Decimal(str(value)) (ingest/fetchers/sosovalue.py:87). The test asserts value == Decimal('190646110.255') and != Decimal.from_float(190646110.255).

The backfill endpoint (/stablecoincharts/{chain}) and the live endpoint (/stablecoinchains) each go through their own parser for ETH, SOL and BNB. The test asserts both give the same reference_period and the same Decimal value. Weakness: the mock feeds both endpoints identical numbers, so this proves the two parsers and the chain mapping agree, not that the real endpoints agree.

The backfill emits BackfilledAlternativeMeFearGreedOk, a slots dataclass with no classification field. The test feeds value_classification='Greed' and asserts no persisted value carries that attribute. It also asserts the request used the limit=0 history URL.

The test asserts BNB stays NOT_DEFINABLE for live fetches and that the backfill only requests BTC, ETH and SOL. The companion test test_btc_stablecoin_supply_remains_not_definable_and_not_backfilled (tests/test_backfill_defillama.py:109) asserts no /Bitcoin chart request is made.
The `uv run pytest -q` gate exited 0 (396 passed). The typecheck gate (mypy --strict) also exited 0.

note: 5 of 6 criteria met, and nothing looks faked. C1 is still unmet on attempt 3: the live SoSoValue probe never got a response (sandbox socket block), the integration tests were deselected, and the window moved from an assumed 200 to a documentation-derived 300 without any live confirmation. The C3 seam test runs on identical mock values, so it only proves the two parsers agree.
